note: Advertised windows are the vendors' published figures (Nov 2026). Effective tokens are CONSERVATIVE WORKING ESTIMATES, roughly half the advertised window (less for 1M-token windows), reflecting published long-context evals (RULER, needle-in-a-haystack) that show retrieval/reasoning degrading well before the advertised limit. They are not vendor claims and not measured benchmarks. Input prices are approximate public list prices, Nov 2026, input tokens only. Verify before budgeting; override per run with --effective-tokens / --price-per-1m.
